text:
dina: FYI nightly perf runs show p95 regressions on chat-complete for free-tier routes after the kernel selector tweak. +~30ms on average, spikes to ~120ms for short-turn queries.

samir: ugh. saw the alert. is this across all sequence lengths or short prefix-heavy requests?

dina: mostly <64 token responses. KV hit-rate looks fine. flamegraph attached from perf-bot below.

perf-bot: flamegraph: https://perf.internal/flame/4765432100 - top stack is runtime::choose_kernel -> batcher::form_batch -> kv_cache::lookup (small samples)

eli: interesting that kernel selector is on the hot path for tiny sequences. maybe the latency to probe kernel variants > benefit for short runs.

mira: agreed. could be we switched to the new kernel that has better throughput at larger batch sizes but higher per-call overhead.

samir: proposal: dynamic token-budget targets by route tier. for free-tier (latency sensitive short queries) cap token budget lower so microbatches form faster and avoid kernel switch. for paid-tier leave current settings.

dina: rough config snippet i was thinking to test (canary to 10% of free-tier traffic):
```json
{
  "route": "chat-complete",
  "tier": "free",
  "token_budget_target": 8,
  "queue_policy": "age-bias",
  "kernel_pref": "low-overhead"
}
```

eli: can we also bias the queue to prefer older requests (age-bias) + strict max-wait (10ms) so batches don't grow waiting for a large request?

mira: +1. add a small KV-prefetch window change: please try prefetch=false for this canary — might cut extra KV work for tiny responses.

samir: I'll wire up canary and add metrics: p95, kernel_switch_count, avg_batch_size, kv_latency. names: slo.p95_ms, runtime.kernel_switches, batch.avg_size, kv.lat_ms.

deploy-bot: canary created: canary-id=cf2a9; target=10% traffic on route=chat-complete tier=free; config=https://deploys.internal/canary/cf2a9

dina: awesome. after 30m let's check p95 and kernel_switch_count. if p95 drops back to baseline we'll scale to 50%.

eli: one caveat — ensure we don't regress cost too much for free-tier by reducing batching efficiency. add a unit test to ensure avg_batch_size doesn't drop below 1.6 for steady load.

mira: noted. i'll also add an A/B trace compare for KV hits between canary/control.

samir: starting the rollout now. will post the first 30m snapshot. :rocket:

perf-bot: first snapshot (30m): slo.p95_ms (control=88ms, canary=61ms), runtime.kernel_switches (control=320, canary=48), batch.avg_size (control=4.1, canary=2.2), kv.lat_ms (control=12ms, canary=9ms)

dina: nice! that looks promising. if numbers hold, we'll promote the config but keep kernel selector tuned for paid tiers.

eli: let's also log an experiment note in the perf notebook and tag the kernel commit so we remember rationale.

mira: will do. creating GH note and linking canary id.

samir: followup action items: 1) widen canary to 50% after 1h if stable; 2) add infra alert if batch.avg_size < 1.2 for >5m; 3) track downstream cost delta for free-tier.

dina: copying action items into the SLO playbook. thanks everyone.

mira: :thumbsup:
